payload.name: pc-check-retry-eligibility
payload.description: Deterministic pure-logic guard that decides whether a logical step invocation is eligible for a bounded retry, before any dispatch is attempted. It returns retry only when the outcome is retryable, the attempt count is below max_attempts, the operation state is not completed, and read_only or dedup_verified is true. Completed effects never replay even when read_only/dedup_verified are true. This is evidence-conditioned pure logic, not dispatch permission: it does not grant dispatch, replace live policy, cancellation, resource limits, attempt freshness or actual deduplication evidence. The consuming Recipe/runner must still check current instance-wide Tool policy, cancellation and fresh execution identity before every permitted retry, and reconcile unknown completion through a supported path rather than inferring no-effect from a missing completion record. The typed inputs interface (operation_state, outcome, attempt, max_attempts, read_only, dedup_verified) is a target contract requiring actual runner support; booleans are exact booleans, not truthy strings/numbers/lists, and missing/null/invalid data fails closed. No I/O, imports or host calls.
payload.content:
operation_state = inputs.get('operation_state')
outcome = inputs.get('outcome')
attempt = inputs.get('attempt')
max_attempts = inputs.get('max_attempts')
read_only = inputs.get('read_only')
dedup_verified = inputs.get('dedup_verified')
valid = (
    type(operation_state) is str and operation_state in ('completed', 'unknown', 'not_started')
    and type(outcome) is str and outcome in ('retryable', 'terminal')
    and type(attempt) is int and not isinstance(attempt, bool) and attempt >= 1
    and type(max_attempts) is int and not isinstance(max_attempts, bool) and max_attempts >= 1
    and type(read_only) is bool
    and type(dedup_verified) is bool
)
retry = False
if valid:
    retry = (outcome == 'retryable' and attempt < max_attempts and operation_state != 'completed' and (read_only or dedup_verified))
result = {'retry': retry}
